facts.fact: The CNPD's members took office on 24 April 2015 and it was declared installed on 10 December 2015.
The CNPD says that from 2015 to 2025 it issued thousands of authorisations and hundreds of opinions and received hundreds of complaints.

note: The Convention 108 accession is not the Malabo Convention, so no treaty fact is recorded.
